audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Lucian five of seven rows on both layers — including Level 6, first item and two items — while this page's own whys say the opposite for every one of them ('Your R knockup at six hard-counters his squishy, dash-reliant kit', 'First item burst deletes a Lucian who built no defenses', 'Late you keep the duel edge').
audit.why: The mirror (lucian__wukong) already set the chart to Skill / Lucian / Skill / Wukong / Wukong / Wukong / Wukong and the packet chart is identical.
audit.corrected: Six rows flipped as matched pairs on both layers with ratings following; Level 2 stays Lucian's.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[2..6].why were template strings that named no spike and pointed the reader at the wrong owner of each stage.
audit.why: The shape is: level 2-3 is his poke window, 4-5 is where a spent Relentless Pursuit lets you close, 6 is Cyclone onto a dash-reliant squishy, and first item is where he simply dies to one rotation because he buys no defences.
audit.corrected: All five rewritten with the mechanic and the cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page's whole plan is 'engage when Relentless Pursuit is down' but it never states the cooldown, and it omits the interaction that decides whether the window exists at all: Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown.
audit.why: Riot's text on E: 'Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown.' The base is 16s at rank 1, which is long enough to be a genuine window — but only if he is not getting attacks off. A player who counts to sixteen while feeding him free double-shots will find the dash back early. That is the difference between the advice working and the advice getting them killed. Also worth having on the page: at rank 5 the dash is free (0 mana).
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t now state the 16s base AND the reduction, and the trade line ends the exchange on his double-shot coming back.

audit.whatIsWrong: No numbers anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Piercing Light is 9s at rank 1 down to 5s at 500 range; The Culling is 110s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Trade rules used generic 'E'/'Q' with no exit cue.
audit.why: The exit cue that matters is his passive double-shot coming back up.
audit.corrected: tradeGood, dosFull[1].d, breakdown.trading and report[3].t rewritten in-band with real names.
